consumer_level_r11.detail: At negChainOnFaithful_iff (Lemma53Faithful.lean, declaration now at :365) the rcases h_INF.first_occ ... with hk | <r0, hr0a, hr0b, hnone, hPr0> split is STRUCTURALLY UNCHANGED under HasFaithfulDedekindINF. Only hk's type moved: kplus M atomMap P.formula z0 -> kplusOpen M atomMap P.formula z0. No third arm, no endpoint by_cases, no added hypothesis. The 66-line proof is otherwise byte-identical apart from two tactic-line renames -- kplusLeftBlock_holds -> kplusOpenLeftBlock_holds in the rw chain, and orderedPointsExist_combine_kplus -> orderedPointsExist_combine_kplusOpen in the boundary-subcase arm. Disjunct (3)'s point type deliberately stays at kplusPred, because HasFaithfulDedekindINF's right disjunct is literally HasDedekindINF's, so nothing at r0 needed to move. The SUP mirror HasFaithfulDedekindSUP.last_occ_tp (Lemma53FaithfulPast.lean:254) is likewise two-arm. The chartered R11 fallback -- re-base onto HasDenseDedekindINF with explicit P(z0) branches -- is NOT triggered. Corroborating effort datum: ZERO failed proof attempts, both scoped builds green on the FIRST attempt, and no proof-search tool (lean_multi_attempt, lean_state_search, lean_hammer_premise) was invoked at any point in the phase.
consumer_level_r11.scope_limit: This settles the two BASE-LAYER destructure sites only: Lemma53Faithful.lean's negChainOnFaithful_iff and Lemma53FaithfulPast.lean's last_occ_tp wrapper. route_critical_findings.finding: CONSUMER-LEVEL R11 HELD at the smallest site. The faithful dichotomy collapses nothing and adds no branch at negChainOnFaithful_iff. Block D proceeds on the PRIMARY charter.

The faithful re-base does NOT make disjunct (2) observable on Prior structures. This was the live risk of weakening the gate: kplus implies kplusOpen, so a weaker gate could in principle have fired where the stronger one cannot, and the module's own exclusion claim would have quietly become false. It does not. prior_makes_faithful_disjunct2_unreachable (Lemma53Faithful.lean:537) and prior_makes_faithful_kminus_disjunct_unreachable (Lemma53FaithfulPast.lean:464) prove BOTH K+ spellings dead under SemanticPriorUZ/SemanticPriorSZ, because attainment kills kplusOpen P z0 outright: an attained first occurrence r0 > z0 with no P on (z0,r0) contradicts P occurring in every (z0,s). Observability of the faithful carrier still requires a genuinely non-attained Dedekind-complete frame class, which this tree does not construct. The two landed exclusion theorems are now DERIVED from these stronger ones, so the pair cannot drift apart.

SURVEY GAP, and it is the material input to Phase 11.1. The Faithful-Subtree Survey did not anticipate that re-basing negChainOnFaithful_iff's BINDER reddens eight call sites inside Phase 11.1's territory, which Phase 11 may not edit. Without a shim, 'full lake build green' and 'EANegationFixFaithful/** read, not edited' are jointly unsatisfiable. Closed with coeHasDedekindINFToFaithful, and Phase 11.1's task list now carries the deletion as an explicit checklist item plus a one-declaration territory exception.

deviations.what: HasDedekindSUP.last_occ_tp re-based ADDITIVELY rather than in place: HasFaithfulDedekindSUP.last_occ_tp landed beside a kept, unchanged HasDedekindSUP.last_occ_tp.
deviations.why: Forced, not chosen. The faithful carrier can only supply kminusOpen P z1 in the left disjunct, and kminusOpen does not imply kminus. An in-place re-base would therefore have strictly WEAKENED a landed conclusion, which the phase's own 'Done when' forbids. The two wrappers are incomparable -- weaker hypothesis AND weaker conclusion -- so neither subsumes the other, and neither has a live consumer to disturb (the only last_occ_tp call sites in the tree resolve to HasAttainedSUP.last_occ_tp in EANegationFix/BoundedFix.lean:72, a different declaration).

deviations.what: coeHasDedekindINFToFaithful, a Coe instance wrapping the landed HasDedekindINF.toHasFaithfulDedekindINF (KPlusFaithful.lean:364).
deviations.why: See the survey-gap finding above. The shim runs in the safe direction only (strong carrier => faithful carrier); the reverse edge does not exist and is not creatable (KPlusFaithful.lean:434-440). It weakens nothing and adds no axiom. It is documented in-file as declared original glue under a section header naming it as such, with an explicit deletion charter, and its load-bearing status was verified by machine rather than assumed.
